        yield Tracker()

    sys.modules['dspy.utils.saving'] = types.SimpleNamespace(get_dependency_versions=lambda: {})

    Example = load('dspy.primitives.example', 'dspy/primitives/example.py').Example
    load('dspy.primitives.prediction', 'dspy/primitives/prediction.py')
    load('dspy.predict.parallel', 'dspy/predict/parallel.py')
    load('dspy.primitives.base_module', 'dspy/primitives/base_module.py')
    Module = load('dspy.primitives.module', 'dspy/primitives/module.py').Module
